dict: Estate (landgoed): usually privately owned. Ask permission, unless an owner area shown on top says otherwise.
Municipal street or park tree (from the municipality's tree register). The municipality's rules for public green apply; no picking policy is known.
Owner unknown. Check the signs, or ask the owner.
Tree in a garden: private ground, ask the owner.
Wild picking only along roads and paths, about one mushroom tub, for your own use. Commercial picking and taking plants, wood or branches is forbidden.
Picking flowers or mushrooms is forbidden in public parks, plantsoenen and municipally maintained green. (Art. 2:45 Bescherming groenvoorziening, APV gemeente Nijmegen)
